g.text: Paper design. Never built, nothing measured.

g.desc: Paper design. Never built, nothing measured.

g.text: Generated from design/circuit.py and hardware/netlist.yaml. Do not edit by hand.

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: 4-ZONE BUILD: instances Z5 to Z8 are not fitted

g.desc: 4-ZONE BUILD: instances Z5 to Z8 are not fitted

g.text: (KiCad variant "4-zone"). Z1 to Z4 and MV always are.

g.desc: (KiCad variant "4-zone"). Z1 to Z4 and MV always are.

g.text: Power stage: triac in the return leg of the valve

g.desc: Power stage: triac in the return leg of the valve

g.text: OUTPUT CHANNEL (hardware design section 6). Nine instances: Z1 to Z8 and MV.

g.desc: OUTPUT CHANNEL (hardware design section 6). Nine instances: Z1 to Z8 and MV.

g.text: The valve sits between a COM terminal and OUT. Current returns through PTC F1, the triac

g.desc: The valve sits between a COM terminal and OUT. Current returns through PTC F1, the triac

g.text: and the shared shunt (ISNS) to GND. The gate is fired from T2 through opto-triac U1 and R3,

g.desc: and the shared shunt (ISNS) to GND. The gate is fired from T2 through opto-triac U1 and R3,

g.text: so gate current has the polarity of T2: quadrants I and III, which every triac supports.

g.desc: so gate current has the polarity of T2: quadrants I and III, which every triac supports.

g.text: Q1 T810-600B-TR, 8 A, three-quadrant, DPAK. Pin 1 A1 (T1) to ISNS, pin 2 and tab A2 (T2), pin 3 gate.

g.desc: Q1 T810-600B-TR, 8 A, three-quadrant, DPAK. Pin 1 A1 (T1) to ISNS, pin 2 and tab A2 (T2), pin 3 gate.

g.text: The tab is net T2: give it its own copper island of 2 cm2 or more (section 6.7).

g.desc: The tab is net T2: give it its own copper island of 2 cm2 or more (section 6.7).

g.text: U1 MOC3023, random phase. LED current 7.0 mA worst case, 12 mA typical; it needs 5.6 mA at -20 C.

g.desc: U1 MOC3023, random phase. LED current 7.0 mA worst case, 12 mA typical; it needs 5.6 mA at -20 C.

g.text: R1 150R sets the opto LED current. R2 680R gives the indicator LED 1.7 mA.

g.desc: R1 150R sets the opto LED current. R2 680R gives the indicator LED 1.7 mA.

g.text: R3 100R limits the opto-triac to 0.45 A at the 45 V peak. R4 1k holds the gate at T1.

g.desc: R3 100R limits the opto-triac to 0.45 A at the 45 V peak. R4 1k holds the gate at T1.

g.text: R5 + C1 47R and 10 nF snubber. F1 PTC 1.1 A hold, 40 A maximum. D1 SMBJ48CA clamps at 77 V.

g.desc: R5 + C1 47R and 10 nF snubber. F1 PTC 1.1 A hold, 40 A maximum. D1 SMBJ48CA clamps at 77 V.

g.text: D2 lights when the expander pin is low AND V_DRV is on: the real drive state.

g.desc: D2 lights when the expander pin is low AND V_DRV is on: the real drive state.

g.text: ZD_N is low to turn the output on. V_DRV is removed by the fail-safe circuit.

g.desc: ZD_N is low to turn the output on. V_DRV is removed by the fail-safe circuit.
